portraits: The 96-pixel faces are the ones that finally read as real, cute people: you can see the lashes, the light in the eyes and the shape of the lips. B is the same drawing at today's size, if you'd rather change less.
gloopgarr: The most fun to fight and the easiest to read: the pink stands out against the green bog, and his swallowed loot spills out when he splits.
grimjaw: He stays a real wolf leading his moss-wolf pack, and the white mane and the broken spear tell his story at a glance, even at night.
wyrm: His head opens into crystal petals just before he sprays shards, so you see the attack coming, and he matches the geodes he drops.
